label: Estonia
trip: One solo visit, Fri Aug 4 to Sun Aug 6, 2023 (Round-the-World year; came by ferry from Helsinki, left by bus for Riga). Fri Aug 4: missed the 7:30 ferry, took the 9:00 one (a cruise-ship ferry with bars, slots and a roof deck); rain; dropped bags at The Monk's Bunk; lunch at Balti Jaama Turg (pork stew, a fig-and-licorice bun, Uzbek samsa); Toompea viewpoints (Patkuli, Kohtuotsa, Bishop's Garden), St. Mary's (Dome) Church, Alexander Nevsky Cathedral; the town wall and towers complex (the Maiden Tower cafe, the Danish flag legend, the professions/weapons museum); Vabamu museum (audio guide, the replica Soviet apartment); evening in Telliskivi with people from the hostel app: F-Hoone (25 dumplings in cream sauce for 8 euros), then Sveta Baar until late. Sat Aug 5: climbed St. Olaf's; laundry (the automated machine in a new mall rejected his US number); the Town Hall Pharmacy; the city walls; St. Catherine's Passage (underwhelming); lunch at Munga Kelder (pork roast, mild sauerkraut, cranberry rye bread); the House of the Blackheads (closed); a small two-room history museum; Pulla bakery (poppyseed bread); nap; dinner at Lido in the Ülemiste mall; a playground by the opera; cards at another hostel. Sun Aug 6: Bolt to the bus station early, 4-hour bus to Riga

albums.Estonia (2023): the visit, Aug 4 to 6, 2023: Aug 4 the ferry from Helsinki, Balti Jaama Turg, Toompea viewpoints, Alexander Nevsky (no photos inside allowed), the wall towers, Vabamu, Telliskivi and Sveta Baar at night; Aug 5 St. Olaf's view, the Town Hall Square and pharmacy, the walls, St. Catherine's Passage, Munga Kelder, the House of the Blackheads, Lido; Aug 6 the bus to Riga. Never use Helsinki (Finland album) or Riga (Latvia album) photos
